case_number: Review Petition (Crl.) Nos. 159-160 of 2013 IN Criminal Appeal Nos. 300-301 of 2011
summary: Review of death penalty conviction under Mohd. Arif precedent; oral hearing mandated for death sentence review petitions; irreversibility of death penalty emphasized; divergent judicial opinions on rarest of rare cases; data shows commutation rate increased post-Mohd. Arif when different benches hear review; death penalty confirmed after re-examination despite procedural review.
legal_provisions_cited: Bachan Singh v. State of Punjab
